note: Snares (Steve 2026-10-25, plan tech/ACTION_PLANS/Steve_hide_traps.md). A set snare (struct kind snare_trap) looks every check_s real seconds, only while a player is within active_m. The chance of a catch is base_chance x the worn-trail factor at the snare x the species weight of the nearest eligible animal within lure_m x bait x night x storm; luck nudges the roll (fate kind snare). A catch takes that animal out of the world and lays its carcass beside the snare (the knife flow, parts, hide and rot are the carcass module's); the snare is quiet avoid_s afterwards (10 game minutes) and wears wear_per_catch and breaks at its durability. While its carcass still lies there the snare is sprung and catches nothing. Deer and bigger are never caught (species not in species_weight). All numbers here.
test_chance_note: Smoke runs only (Tyler 25 Oct): above 0, every look at a set snare catches an imagined rabbit with this chance; the server prints a line at load while it is on. Keep 0.
draw_note: MikeW 3 Nov: rabbits and foxes stay within a few metres of home, so almost none ever came within lure_m of a snare (0 of 4,800 looks in tools/snare_odds.gd). Now a look with nothing inside lure_m picks the nearest draw_species animal within draw_m and rolls the catch chance x draw_share; on success that animal moves its home to the snare and grazes there, so a later look can catch it. A snare on a worn run draws far more often (trail_factor).
species_weight_note: Part C plan 3 (10 Nov 2026): birds are caught by the bird trap, not the snare (item_system), so the duck is off the snare's list. A species with no carcass.json row is never caught (the catch would leave nothing).
say_cap: You already have six snares out. The oldest one is taken back.
say_near: A snare needs open ground, well away from buildings.
say_broke: A snare broke on its catch.

bird_trap_set.note: The Bird trap (Part C plan 3, 10 Nov 2026): the bird_trap kit is set like a snare (struct kind bird_trap_set), with these numbers laid over the snare's. It catches only ground birds (species_weight); one living within draw_m may wander over to it at the catch chance x draw_share. Birds keep to no runs, so the worn-trail factor is flat; they roost at night (night_mult under 1). Grain or other food within bait_m baits it. Its own cap of per_player.
